verdict.rationale: Sierra is a SaaS agent platform with an SDK, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI paths all returned 404. The SDK, journeys-as-code and MCP gateway mentions do not show a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
